resolved_findings.title: Supplied pre-expanded PEFT model embedding state now survives federated payloads and checkpoints
resolved_findings.resolution: Trainer compares actual current embedding size with self.config.vocab_size from its independently loaded exact configured original model revision. resolved_findings.actual_new_regression_result: PASS in independent 25-test run, including payload independence, Algorithm load, checkpoint load and exact restored logits.

verified_passes: Exact frozen commit/tree remained clean. All 15 source SHA256 entries in the correction receipt match; original historical receipt remains byte-identical to d3569ec and only the two corrected source paths differ from its original hashes.

Original edge reproducer independently rerun against this candidate: both in-Trainer and caller-preexpanded vocabulary 256 to 257 paths include input/output embedding weights in real PEFT payloads and checkpoints and restore logits exactly (maximum error 0). Config reloads forbidden during extraction/export.

Independent 48-case float64 SGD/momentum accumulation oracle passed with maximum parameter error0: steps 1/2/3/4, counts 1/2/3/5/6/7, both last-batch and finalize tail paths. Optimizer counts, pre/post callbacks, scheduler advancement, counter clearing and repeated-finalize idleness all match.

Independent actual PEFT tiny native Qwen3 payload probe passed q/v, saved head, embedding-LoRA and explicit expanded-vocabulary variants. No CPU aliases, changed snapshots, hidden config reloads or payload round-trip errors; required modules/embeddings retained and ordinary frozen base excluded.

Six additional independent actual PEFT mutation-and-reload variants passed: q/v, modules_to_save head, modules_to_save input embedding, embedding-LoRA list target, embedding-LoRA regex target and trainable token indices. Both production payload load and checkpoint load restore logits exactly; malformed checkpoint shapes reject before any active-state mutation.

All 25 focused new tests passed with 10 visible warnings and no skips/xfails/deselections. Includes offline real tiny Qwen/PEFT 2/3 weighted updates through production server aggregation, every-tensor oracle, unchanged frozen base, checkpoints/snapshots, exact artifact revisions and bad-pin failure, dataset cache identity, configured seed and actual HF tail callback/control/scheduler integration.

Source review confirms explicitly configured model/tokenizer revisions flow to every maintained loader and PEFT revision. trust_remote_code=False and supported token/dtype arguments are used. Failures have no retry-main/random fallback. Legacy unspecified revision defaults are explicit in artifact_identity and distinct from failure fallback.
Raw HF dataset cache identity includes explicit dataset revision and resolved local file path plus streaming content SHA256. Pinned/local inputs cannot use legacy unpinned caches.

Configured trainer seed drives actual adapter initialization and client-specific training Torch seed. An independent actual no-seed initialization check preserves incoming RNG variation; configurations without trainer.random_seed are not newly forced to a seed.

Fresh official pretrained qualification JSON and log match committed correction evidence. All reported numerical/hash fields plus client losses exactly equal original qualification. Official cached config/model file sizes and streaming SHA256 match original evidence; original vocabulary and actual checkpoint input embedding header are both 151936.

Historical actual-transport CLI JSON, wrapper and log hashes verified, including all 8 transfer lines, 2.22 MB each direction/client, both comm_simulation=false, exit 0, natural shutdown and no survivors. Exactly one visible resource_tracker semaphore warning remains. It is correctly presented as d3569ec history.

Ordinary Qwen correction predicate is false because current embedding size equals pinned original 151936. Config, transport/checkpoint interfaces and remaining source hashes are unchanged, and fresh real qualification is numerically identical. This supports ordinary behavior equivalence without claiming a fresh CLI rerun.

focused_tests.result: 25 passed, 10 warnings; no skips, xfails, deselections.

independent_execution.reviewer_scratch_adaptation: Only scratch was changed. The edge reproducer differs only in output directory. The standalone Algorithm payload fixture has no Trainer, so its expanded-vocabulary case establishes plato_save_embedding_layers from its explicitly preserved original vocabulary and actual pre-wrapper embedding size. Trainer detection itself is independently exercised by the unchanged edge logic and the actual new regression. One initial scratch attempt read num_embeddings through the embedding-LoRA wrapper and failed; the scratch fixture was corrected to capture the embedding size before wrapping, then all 48 accumulation and 4 payload cases passed.

limitations: No source edits, nested agents, commits or external service calls. Scratch reports/scripts only; existing model cache read without download or mutation.

This reviewer independently reran offline focused tests and numerical/persistence probes, but did not rerun the 596M official qualification or socket CLI. Both supplied runs were read and hash-bound to committed evidence.

Actual-transport CLI remains a historical d3569ec observation. Source equivalence for the ordinary reference and fresh real numerical qualification support its applicability; no claim of a current-correction CLI execution.

Tiny native random Qwen tests establish architecture/runtime behavior, separate from official pretrained qualification. Fixture metrics are not benchmark quality/convergence evidence; no full optimizer resume or Python 3.14 qualification claim.
CLI used two serial logical clients with max_concurrency 1. Its aggregate RSS is sampled process-group RSS; qualification peak RSS is single-process and not directly comparable.

The historical CLI has one visible semaphore-cleanup warning. Its cause is not conclusively attributed to new HF/LoRA code; natural exit and absence of survivors are verified and warning was not suppressed.
Retirement archives/docs, packaging/hosted CI, combined repository suites and overall task acceptance remain root review/integration scope.
